en.title: A weekend without a plan
en.excerpt: Two days on the coast with no itinerary and one very good bakery.
en.content:
Two days on the coast with no itinerary and one very good bakery. We left the map in the glove box and followed whichever road looked least busy.

The bakery appeared at the wrong time — too early for lunch, too late for breakfast — which made it perfect. We bought bread we didn't need and ate it on a bench facing the sea.

Nothing was scheduled. Nothing was missed.
en.author: June Marsk
